PreToolUse.command: python -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('toolArgs',{}).get('path','') or d.get('toolArgs',{}).get('file_path','') or ''; protected=['.env','package-lock.json']; sys.exit(2 if any(fp.endswith(x) for x in protected) or '.git/' in fp else 0)"
PreToolUse.description: Block edits to .env, package-lock.json, and .git/ paths

PostToolUse.command: python -c "import sys,json,os,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; d=json.load(sys.stdin); fp=d.get('toolArgs',{}).get('path','') or d.get('toolArgs',{}).get('file_path','') or ''; (sys.exit(0) if not fp.endswith('tasks.md') else None); root=Path(__file__).parent; os.chdir(root); subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/'scripts/rebuild_excel.py')],capture_output=True); print('PostToolUse: Excel rebuild done')"
PostToolUse.description: Rebuild Excel spreadsheet when tasks.md is edited
